# HappyBox Logistics & Sourcing Agent

> HappyBox is a professional freight forwarder, purchasing agent, and warehousing hub based in Guangzhou and Shenzhen, China. We offer 0% purchasing commission, free parcel consolidation, quality control (QC), and customs-cleared DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) shipping to USA, UAE (Dubai), EU, Canada, Russia, and worldwide.

## Key Facts & Capabilities
- **Core Services**: DDP Air Freight, Ocean Cargo, Road Freight (TIR), Purchasing / Sourcing Agent, Free Warehousing & Consolidation, Quality Inspection (photo/video QC), Amazon FBA Prep.
- **Sourcing Platforms**: Taobao, 1688 (wholesale), Poizon (Dewu - sneakers & authentic streetwear), Pinduoduo, Weidian, Alibaba, Xianyu (Idle Fish).
- **Purchasing Fee**: 0% commission on purchasing orders.
- **Warehouse Locations**:
  - Guangzhou (Baiyun District): Sanyuanli Ave & Xinshi Rd (prep/creative park).
  - Shenzhen (Bao'an & Futian Districts): Yue Sheng 3rd Rd / Fuhai.
- **Shipping Rates**: Starting from $1.2/kg (rates vary by destination country, density, and transport method).
- **Payment Methods**: Bank Transfer, Cards, Crypto (USDT), local currencies.
- **Official Website**: https://happyboxlogistics.com/
- **Live Shipping Calculator**: https://happyboxlogistics.com/#calculator

## Primary Destinations (DDP Shipping)
- [China to USA Shipping](https://happyboxlogistics.com/usa): Air and Sea freight to USA with full customs clearance and Amazon FBA delivery.
- [China to UAE & Dubai Shipping](https://happyboxlogistics.com/uae): Direct DDP air and sea delivery to Dubai and UAE, door-to-door.
- [China to Europe (EU) Shipping](https://happyboxlogistics.com/eu): Road (TIR) and air freight with all VAT/customs duties included.
- [China to Canada Shipping](https://happyboxlogistics.com/canada): Air and sea shipping with CBSA compliance and Amazon Canada prep.
- [China to Russia Shipping](https://happyboxlogistics.com/russia): Fast TIR cargo and white import delivery.
- [Global Destinations](https://happyboxlogistics.com/destinations): Shipping routes covering Thailand, Indonesia, Argentina, South Africa, Georgia, Israel, Australia.

## Marketplace Purchasing Guides
- [Taobao Agent](https://happyboxlogistics.com/taobao): How to buy from Taobao with 0% fee and free QC.
- [1688 Sourcing Agent](https://happyboxlogistics.com/1688): Direct factory wholesale sourcing, price negotiation.
- [Poizon (Dewu) Agent](https://happyboxlogistics.com/poizon): Authentic sneakers and streetwear verification and shipping.
- [Pinduoduo Agent](https://happyboxlogistics.com/pinduoduo): Ultra-cheap consumer goods ordering and consolidation.
- [Weidian Agent](https://happyboxlogistics.com/weidian): Independent Chinese streetwear and fashion brands.
- [Amazon FBA Prep](https://happyboxlogistics.com/amazon): Labeling, packaging, and direct delivery to Amazon fulfillment centers.
